name: cut-fork
prompt: Generate an image. I'm making prop sprites for a top-down party game played on a dinner table. One object per image, all in exactly the same art style: bold chunky cartoon game art, thick dark-brown outlines, flat bright colours with soft cel shading and one crisp white highlight, very readable at small size. Object centred, filling about 85% of the frame, solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) background, no shadow, no text, no border, nothing else. Square 1:1 image. First: a shiny silver dinner FORK lying flat, seen from directly above, perfectly horizontal, handle on the LEFT and the four tines pointing to the RIGHT.
